messages:
Aria (Customer): Hey team — embedding the widget in our iOS app. After a promo blast we saw a sudden spike in preflight failures: a bunch of 429s, a couple 503s. No app code deploy between good and bad. Logs show `preflight: 429 token_pool_exhausted`
Maya (CS): Oof. Can you confirm how you mint ephemerals and the client SDK version? Also are you using direct client minting or server-proxied tokens?
Aria (Customer): sdk-ios v0.9.3. We mint ephemeral tokens on our auth service and hand them to the client. The mobile team pushed a change to reconnect WS on background/foreground to improve realtime — could that be the culprit?
OnboardBot: alert: preflight-rate-window exceeded (429 spike) — 18 requests/min from origin `app.example.com`. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/rate-limits
Rafael (Infra Eng): Yes, background/foreground reconnects can cause token stampedes if each reconnect triggers a fresh preflight. Quick diagnostics: check ephemeral TTL (short <25s bad), count of preflight requests per minute for that origin, and whether tokens are cached per session.
Sam (SDK): Two immediate fixes on client: (1) session cache the ephemeral token across WS reconnects, (2) add jittered coalescing when multiple requests for a token occur in a short window. Example (Swift):
```swift
// naive coalesce + jitter
var preflightPending = false
func requestPreflight() {
  guard !preflightPending else { return }
  preflightPending = true
  let jitter = UInt32.random(in: 0...250)
  DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + .milliseconds(100 + Int(jitter))) {
    HTTP.get("/auth/ephemeral") { _ in
      preflightPending = false
    }
  }
}
```
Maya (CS): Short-term we can grant a temporary preflight quota increase and route you to a cheaper model variant to avoid 503s while you stabilize. Would you like a 48-hour bump?
Aria (Customer): 48h would be perfect. We can ship the session-cache + coalesce in ~3 hours. Any advice on server-side patterns to avoid cost/regressions?
Rafael (Infra Eng): Server-side: return the same ephemeral for simultaneous requests from the same user origin for a small window (e.g., 5s). Also emit `X-RW-Advice: coalesce` and `Retry-After` when we detect fanout. On our infra we'll enable a temporary circuit-breaker: if >6 concurrent preflights from same origin, respond with 429 + `Retry-After: 2` and log to the new dashboard.
Sam (SDK): If you can't change clients quickly, proxy the ephemeral through your server: have clients call your server once, server performs single preflight and hands out a short-lived token copy to concurrent clients. That avoids many origin-level preflights.
Maya (CS): Action list: 1) Maya -> apply 48h preflight quota bump (pending Aria confirm) 2) Aria -> deploy session cache + coalesce (ETA 3h) 3) Rafael -> enable circuit-breaker monitor for token-origin fanout and add dashboard link here when ready 4) Sam -> upload small iOS helper lib for coalescing and a server-proxy example.
Aria (Customer): Confirmed, please apply the 48h bump. We'll notify when rollout is complete. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
Maya (CS): Done — 48h preflight quota increase applied. Monitoring flagged; we'll watch for cost impact and can rollback early if needed.
Rafael (Infra Eng): I'll post the dashboard URL once the monitor is live and wire an alert to the CS channel if fanout returns.
Sam (SDK): I'll drop the iOS helper package and a tiny Node example for server-proxy in this thread in ~30m. :package:
